description: Security posture check of a web server (no port scanning): TLS protocol support (legacy 1.0/1.1 detection via a Korean network probe), security headers (HSTS/CSP/X-Content-Type-Options/anti-clickjacking/Referrer-Policy), HTTP→HTTPS redirect, and certificate key/signature strength. Returns per-item pass/warn/fail and an overall grade.
name: check_security
